user.title: Green Hero
user.description: Choose how to connect your Green Hero account.

browser.title: Log in to Green Hero
browser.description:
1. Open this link and sign in:

[Sign in to Green Hero]({url})

2. After signing in you'll land on a Green Hero page that may show an error — that's expected.
3. Copy the **full URL** from your browser's address bar (it contains `?code=...`) and paste it below.

refresh_token.title: Green Hero refresh token
refresh_token.description: Paste a refresh_token from a logged-in Green Hero web session (browser console: read the `@@auth0spajs@@` localStorage entry).

error.invalid_auth: Could not authenticate with that value. Try the login link again.
error.invalid_code: Couldn't find a code in what you pasted. Paste the full redirect URL.
error.no_refresh_token: Login succeeded but no refresh token was returned. Try again.
